title: Release 0.2.0
lead: Prepare release 0.2.0: clean up the review notes filed on this item, verify the record-format compatibility claim against the real v0.1.0 binary, and turn CHANGELOG '## Unreleased' into '## 0.2.0 - DATE'. Tagging and pushing stay with the owner.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** new behaviour; the edge cases deferred to S40 (import re-run commands and links, refusing the store as DIR, concurrent imports, symlinked DIR, Save symlink/fsync, lock release at process death); Windows CI results (the owner pushes after this slice; CI runs then); creating or pushing the v0.2.0 tag; the JSON freeze and unknown-event tolerance (S39); slicer catalog records (record C32 decisions as slicer notes on S37).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision 2026-10-18: release 0.2.0 after S34-S36, S38, S18-S20 and S22 (0.2.0 first, 1.0 later as S39); the owner runs S37 before pushing, then pushes, checks CI (including the new Windows job) and tags v0.2.0. The notes on this item list the review later notes to clear in a docs and test pass.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Docs and comment nits from the notes: PROJECT.md Later ('re-prioritized or added'; the list is now just S37/S39 and S40 later, keep it accurate), PROJECT.md ~235-247 inbox --all text out of the data-model User config block (trim the repeat of README), the PROJECT.md command-table inbox row (drop [--root DIR] like other rows), internal/commands/context.go 'at least ten' -> nine bytes, README CI paragraph mentions go vet on Windows, over-width lines (AGENTS.md ~203 and others, README ~393, CHANGELOG ~41, lock_unix.go:23, lock_windows.go:61, lock_open.go:18).
- The inbox usage line in help, README, AGENTS.md, PROJECT.md: a form that does not suggest --all --root or -i --json are allowed (e.g. 'adj inbox [--json] [--root DIR] | adj inbox --all [--json] | adj inbox -i [--by NAME] [--root DIR]' as separate usage lines); keep the usage test pinned.
- Tests: a hook so lock tests in internal/commands and internal/userconfig use a short timeout instead of the production 5 s (test-only seam, production unchanged); remove the package-level acquireLock var race risk in userconfig (pass the lock func through, or document and keep tests non-parallel: C32); internal/commands/importadr_test.go ~1308 seen[0] nil-safe.
- CHANGELOG.md: '## Unreleased' -> '## 0.2.0 - 2026-10-18' (the owner may change the date at tagging); make sure every user-visible change since 0.1.0 is listed (context --max-bytes, --ref filters, repos, inbox --all, inbox -i, import-adr, Windows lock/CI/zips, .gitattributes, the import history event) and the JSON-shape changes are named, per the 0.x promise.
- Compatibility claim: build adj from the v0.1.0 tag (git worktree add .cache/tmp/s37-v010 v0.1.0, or git archive into .cache/tmp; never touch main's tree) and confirm what 0.1.0 does on a store with an import entry; fix the CHANGELOG/README wording to what it actually does. Remove that temp worktree afterwards (git worktree remove).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The lock-timeout hook: a test that the short timeout is used (e.g. the held-lock test completes well under 5 s) and production uses 5 s.
- importadr_test nit: the assertion fails cleanly (not panics) when seen is empty.
- Usage text test updated for the new inbox usage lines.
- Docs-only changes need no test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Work through each note on S37 except those S40 now owns; say per note in the report: done, or why not.
2. Tests first for the hook, the nit and the usage line.
3. Verify the v0.1.0 claim with a real v0.1.0 build, then fix the wording.
4. CHANGELOG 0.2.0 section; README install text still right for the new archives (8: six tar.gz, two zip).
5. Record C32 decisions as slicer notes on S37.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- . scripts/env.sh; go test ./... (should be noticeably faster after the hook); go vet ./...; GOOS=windows go vet ./...; gofmt -l cmd internal prints nothing.
- go build -o .cache/bin/adj ./cmd/adj; adj lint --root . clean; adj --help and adj inbox --help read correctly.
- release.yml check: its CHANGELOG section lookup finds '## 0.2.0' (read the workflow's extraction step and run the same shell locally against CHANGELOG.md).
- Mutation check each new test; slicer check --json is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree .worktrees/s37 on branch s37. The orchestrator commits on s37 after VERDICT: PASS and slicer done; no push, no merge, no tag; no AI attribution.
